name: Clash Distribution
purpose: Package the CLI, stdio MCP surface, skills, and internal local-api host as the single installable clash npm package.
runtimeBoundary: The clash dispatcher selects the CLI for ordinary arguments and the peer stdio MCP for `clash mcp`. Both use one discoverable local-api daemon. Desktop carries the same host runtime and reuses the compatible machine singleton; client or Desktop shutdown does not stop the shared daemon.
